Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: When first opening the French Wikipedia page for André Beaunier, WebSurfer reported the birthplace as Paris (“né le 22 septembre 1869 à Paris1”), misreading/misreporting the entry. Subsequent views of the same page and other sources show the correct birthplace is Évreux. This incorrect extraction introduced the wrong birthplace and conflicted with reliable evidence indicating Évreux.
